==Crack the Clue III==
* '''Ned:''' Good work! I have new information to share with you. Listen carefully, now!
* '''Ned:''' A place 65 steps forward and 17 to the right needs an inspection. The weather vane up high will guide you in the right direction.
* '''Ned:''' Under the ground lies the next clue you seek. Getting it out requires a little technique.
* {{tbox|pic=Clue scroll (special) detail.png|You've found a new special clue! However, a magical force prevents you from putting this item in your inventory!}}
* {{tact|Interface showing the next clue opens.}}
